Slop 3D · free, in your browser

Convert GLB to OBJ

Some tools only take OBJ. Import your GLB or glTF into Slop 3D, check it in the viewport, and export it as OBJ, with no converter to install.

Convert a GLB

How to do it

  1. Choose Import and pick the .glb or .gltf file.
  2. Check the model in the viewport, and delete or move parts if you need to.
  3. Choose Export > Export OBJ….

Your files stay on this device: Slop 3D runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

What does the OBJ contain?

Vertex positions, normals and faces. No UV coordinates, no MTL file and no materials, so colours and textures are not carried over.

Can I convert OBJ to GLB?

Not yet. Slop 3D exports OBJ and its own .s3d scene format, but not GLB.

Is the file uploaded?

No. The conversion happens in your browser.
